title: Umphefumlo Olindileyo Ngaselunxwemeni Lomlambo
intro: Umphefumlo omncinci waphathiswa umsebenzi oyimfihlo, wokubukela umgama okhuselekileyo njengoko ikamva lisenzeka emanzini. Engabonwa kwaye engacingelwanga, lo mntu wayeza kudlala indima ebalulekileyo ekutshintsheni imbali yesizwe.
clues: Umama wandinika umsebenzi, owawufuna ukucacelwa nokulumka.
Amehlo am alandela ibhere elincinci elalihamba phezu komsinga, intliziyo yam ikhathazekile.
Xa yafunyanwa liqela elingalindelwanga, ndasondela, ndizele luloyiko.
Ndabona ukuphelelwa lithemba kwabo ngomntu oza kubagcina, ndaza ndabanika isisombululo ngaphandle kokutyhila inyaniso.
Ukungenelela kwam ngexesha elifanelekileyo kwabuyisela umphefumlo onobubele kulowo wawufuna kakhulu.
Kwiinkundla zabantu abanamandla, ndathi: 'Ndingakukhombisa usapho oluza kumondla luze lumnyamekele ngononophelo?'
arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
